instruction: I ran "goenv install 1.19.0" in terminal and received "goenv: command not found". Could you help me resolve this so goenv works immediately?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.verification_notes: Used existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter. Checked for GOENV_ROOT in .bashrc which is the standard goenv configuration pattern.
